text: Vessel design pressure and design temperature shall be set from the maximum operating conditions of the process cases plus a margin: design pressure at least 10 % (or 1.5 bar, whichever is greater) above the maximum operating pressure or the relief valve set pressure, and design temperature at least 15 K above the maximum operating temperature; vacuum service shall be full vacuum. The values shall agree with the equipment register (design_pressure, design_temperature).
